r.경제 체제: Market economy · tourism, footwear, cork, car parts
r.주식시장 시가총액: $61.9 billion, 26% of GDP (2018, listed domestic companies)
r.빅맥지수: $7.08 for a Big Mac, $0.86 more than in the US (Jul 2026, The Economist, euro-area average)
r.생활 물가 수준: 65% of the US level (2025, World Bank, household consumption at purchasing power parity against the market exchange rate)
r.주요 수출품: Vehicles, parts 12%, Electronics, electrical equipment 9%, Machinery, computers 6%, Pharmaceuticals 6%, Refined petroleum 5% (2025, share of all exports, top 5)
r.한국이 파는 것: Cars 19%, Semiconductors 14%, Vaccines, blood products 9%, Hot-rolled steel 9% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Vaccines, blood products 11%, Tires 10%, T-shirts 10%, Machinery, computers 10% (2025, share of value)
r.한국과 맺은 FTA: Korea-EU FTA (provisionally applied 2011, fully in force 2015)
r.정치 구도: A parliamentary system; the president is directly elected but plays a mostly ceremonial role.

t.why: It keeps close ties with Portuguese-speaking countries such as Brazil and Angola.
t.rel: It shares the Iberian Peninsula with Spain and has close ties with Portuguese-speaking former colonies such as Brazil and Angola.
t.know: It produces about half the world's cork.
t.etext: It sells tourism, footwear, textiles, cork, wine and car parts. After a debt crisis in 2011, it recovered while paying down debt.
